# MonShop: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code bf89dfc0115c · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** See what independent shops, cafés and restaurants near you have today, from real shelf photos and specials, and get 5% off where you are a regular.
**Live:** https://monshop.ca · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/monshop · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/monshop/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py monshop` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Native Forms since 2026-11-08** (branch `forms`, folder `monshop-forms`); merged to master the same day (the classic
  version with HTML strings built in Python lives on only in the retired folder `monshop`). Same server code, tables and `#addresses`.
- **Routing**: `router._pick()` maps `#welcome #map[/words] #fresh #shop/<id> #saved #sell #sell/new #sell/<id>
  #sell/<id>/settings #council #admin` to a page (no PAGES table; bare `#` = welcome for visitors, map for members;
  unknown = map). `#sell` decides: visitor = pitch (Pages/Sell), no place yet = Pages/Onboard, else the dashboard.
  `Shell.refresh(nav, mode)` sets the active tab and the shell mode (`landing` hides the nav, `map` = full-height map, no
  footer). On phones the header nav becomes the bottom tab bar in CSS only.
- **Signing in is a dialog** (`state.ask_login()` -> Dialogs/AuthDialog), never a page: pages stay put and decide what
  visitors see (Saved shows a join card, Sell the pitch, Admin asks then shows "Admins only").
- **Server errors are exceptions** (PermissionDenied with friendly text), not `{ok: False}`: `state.call()` shows the
  toast and returns `state.FAIL` (check `is state.FAIL`; `None` is a real reply, e.g. get_dashboard with no place).
  "Please sign in" opens the sign-in dialog and retries once.
- **JavaScript engines** (theme/assets/monshop.js, `window.ms`): photo shrinking (`prepareImage`, wrapped by
  client_code/photos.py), the accent/typo/wildcard search (`setIndex`/`search`/`highlight`, used by Pages/MapPage and
  Items/PlaceCard + Hit), confetti, the pass clock, browser storage (`ms.loc`). Leaflet is the map engine:
  client_code/mapkit.py, owned by Components/MapView (`map_view.setup(...)` returns the engine; it starts on the
  component's show event and queues calls until then). Pins and popups are small HTML strings drawn by Leaflet.
- **Styles**: app.css = the classic theme.css rules, each `.ms-btn.x` / `.ms-chip` / `.ob-cat` / `.cn-vote` /
  `.ms-input` rule also matching the Anvil component with the same roles (`prop:role='["ms-btn", "teal", "lg"]'` ->
  `.anvil-role-ms-btn.anvil-role-teal > button`). When adding a button style, write both selectors. Then the design
  kit block, then the Forms-only parts and the role layer (notifications, dialogs, panels) at the end.
  theme.css = only the loading spinner. Light only (the classic app had no dark mode).
- **Lists** are RepeatingPanels; items raise `x-...` events on their panel (x-pick chips, x-open, x-edit/x-flip/x-delete
  on the shelf, x-review/x-resolve/x-status/x-note in admin). Grid/flex goes on `.anvil-role-<role> > div`.
- Names people type use Figtree, never Fraunces (it misdraws Latvian macrons): `.nm`, `.sp-special .s-t` and friends.
- Validator: attributes first set to None use `state.loose(None)` (the browser's Python has no `typing`).
- Tests: `tools/testing/test_server.py` (strict mock: every callable family, permissions); `tools/ui/smoke.js`
  (every address signed out / new member through onboarding / admin tabs, 1280 and 390 px). Local App Server: container monshop-dev on port 3872.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
